"title": "Resolve missing signature on paperwork",
"text": "Use this checklist to clear a missing signature exception:\n- Identify the exact document, page, section, and signer needed.\n- Confirm whether the signature must be wet ink, electronic, notarized, medallion guaranteed, or witnessed.\n- Verify signer capacity, such as individual owner, trustee, authorized officer, custodian, agent under power of attorney, or spouse.\n- Compare signature requirements against account registration and current custodian instructions.\n- Send the signer a concise request with the corrected form and signing instructions.\n- Confirm all initials, dates, checkboxes, and related acknowledgments are complete before resubmission.\n- Save the corrected version in the approved document location and update the exception notes.\nApply this to obtain signed W‑9 forms and written scopes of work for the two design subcontractor invoices pending payment for Cloudberry Kite Studio.",
